//Legendry hero scriptsetsilence trueset minPol 100set minAtk 130set minIntel 110gosub improvehero %minPol% %minAtk% %minIntel%if {%_0%==0} goto endsleep 4:00:00loopgoto end# syntax: gosub improvehero minPol minAtk minIntel# return 0 if success, -1 if still need improvement, -2 iferror expression goto labellabel improveheroset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().GetRandomHero()$label improvehero_startgosub waitresponse %resp% 10if {%_0%==1} gosubreturn -2# echo $%resp%.toDebugString()$set _h %resp%.randomherobeanecho "Current hero attributes: $%_h%.management$ $%_h%.power$ $%_h%.stratagem$, reset: $%_h%.resetcount$"set _pol {$%_h%.management$>=%_1%}set _atk {$%_h%.power$>=%_2%}set _intel {$%_h%.stratagem$>=%_3%}if {%_pol%&&%_atk%&&%_intel%} gosubreturn 0 // all good attributesif {$%_h%.resetcount$==0} gosubreturn -1 // no more spinsset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().RetSetHeroAttri(%_pol%,%_atk%,%_intel%,false)$goto improvehero_start# syntax: gosub waitresponse responseHandle maxTimeInSecond# return: 0 if response is available, 1 if time outlabel waitresponseset _starttime $m_city.getRawTime()$label waitresponse_startiferror {$%_1%.ok$} waitresponse_waitgosubreturn 0label waitresponse_waitif {$m_city.getRawTime()$>{%_starttime%+%_2%*1000}} gosubreturn 1sleep 0.05goto waitresponse_start

import flash.events.Event;import flash.events.ProgressEvent;import autoevony.common.Utils;import flash.net.Socket;import flash.utils.ByteArray;function datahandler(event:ProgressEvent):int{c.cm.logMsg("Received message.");var sock:Socket = c.m_techLevels.sock;var fo:ByteArray = new ByteArray();var by:int = sock.bytesAvailable;sock.readBytes(fo,0,by);var amount:int = fo.readObject();if (c.m_techLevels.lastupdate!=c.m_techLevels.lastsold){c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=c.m_techLevels.lastupdate;}var total:int=c.m_techLevels.totalsold;var price:int =1;var extra:int =0;for each(var j:int=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray.length;j>0;j--){extra+=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].amount;price=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].price;if ((extra>=(200000000+(2*total)))||((extra-total)*price>=2*amount)){break;}}var am:int = Math.min(int(amount/price),99999999);var v:ByteArray = new ByteArray;v.writeObject([am,price]);sock.writeBytes(v);sock.flush();c.cm.logMsg("Buying "+String(am)+" at price "+String(price));}function priceupdater(restype:int):int{if (c.m_techLevels.killsignal){return 1;}c.af.getTradeCommands().searchTrades(restype,getCallback("updatehandler"));Utils.callLater(100,getCallback("priceupdater"),[restype])}function updatehandler(evt:Object):int{c.m_techLevels.sellersArray=evt.sellersArray;c.m_techLevels.lastupdate= new Date().getTime();}function main(restype:int):int{var sock:Socket = new Socket();c.m_techLevels.sock=sock;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=0;c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;sock.connect('127.0.0.1',801);sock.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.SOCKET_DATA,setCallback(datahandler));setCallback(updatehandler);setCallback(priceupdater);c.m_techLevels.restype=restype;c.m_techLevels.killsignal=false;priceupdater(restype);}echo $m_dyn.main(0)$

import flash.events.Event;import flash.events.ProgressEvent;import autoevony.common.Utils;import flash.net.Socket;import flash.utils.ByteArray;function datahandler(event:ProgressEvent):int{c.cm.logMsg("Received message.");var sock:Socket = c.m_techLevels.sock;var fo:ByteArray = new ByteArray();var by:int = sock.bytesAvailable;sock.readBytes(fo,0,by);var amount:int = fo.readObject();if (c.m_techLevels.lastupdate!=c.m_techLevels.lastsold){c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=c.m_techLevels.lastupdate;}var total:int=c.m_techLevels.totalsold;var price:int =1;var extra:int =0;for each(var j:int=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray.length;j>0;j--){extra+=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].amount;price=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].price;if ((extra>=(200000000+(2*total)))||((extra-total)*price>=2*amount)){break;}}var am:int = Math.min(int(amount/price),99999999);var v:ByteArray = new ByteArray;v.writeObject([am,price]);sock.writeBytes(v);sock.flush();c.cm.logMsg("Buying "+String(am)+" at price "+String(price));}function priceupdater(restype:int):int{if (c.m_techLevels.killsignal){return 1;}c.af.getTradeCommands().searchTrades(restype,getCallback("updatehandler"));Utils.callLater(100,getCallback("priceupdater"),[restype])}function updatehandler(evt:Object):int{c.m_techLevels.sellersArray=evt.sellersArray;c.m_techLevels.lastupdate= new Date().getTime();}function main(restype:int):int{var sock:Socket = new Socket();c.m_techLevels.sock=sock;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=0;c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;sock.connect('127.0.0.1',801);sock.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.SOCKET_DATA,setCallback(datahandler));setCallback(updatehandler);setCallback(priceupdater);c.m_techLevels.restype=restype;c.m_techLevels.killsignal=false;priceupdater(restype);}echo $m_dyn.main(0)$

//Legendry hero scriptsetsilence trueset minPol 100set minAtk 130set minIntel 110gosub improvehero %minPol% %minAtk% %minIntel%if {%_0%==0} goto endsleep 4:00:00loopgoto end# syntax: gosub improvehero minPol minAtk minIntel# return 0 if success, -1 if still need improvement, -2 iferror expression goto labellabel improveheroset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().GetRandomHero()$label improvehero_startgosub waitresponse %resp% 10if {%_0%==1} gosubreturn -2# echo $%resp%.toDebugString()$set _h %resp%.randomherobeanecho "Current hero attributes: $%_h%.management$ $%_h%.power$ $%_h%.stratagem$, reset: $%_h%.resetcount$"set _pol {$%_h%.management$>=%_1%}set _atk {$%_h%.power$>=%_2%}set _intel {$%_h%.stratagem$>=%_3%}if {%_pol%&&%_atk%&&%_intel%} gosubreturn 0 // all good attributesif {$%_h%.resetcount$==0} gosubreturn -1 // no more spinsset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().RetSetHeroAttri(%_pol%,%_atk%,%_intel%,false)$goto improvehero_start# syntax: gosub waitresponse responseHandle maxTimeInSecond# return: 0 if response is available, 1 if time outlabel waitresponseset _starttime $m_city.getRawTime()$label waitresponse_startiferror {$%_1%.ok$} waitresponse_waitgosubreturn 0label waitresponse_waitif {$m_city.getRawTime()$>{%_starttime%+%_2%*1000}} gosubreturn 1sleep 0.05goto waitresponse_startsleep 86000loop

//Legendry hero scriptsetsilence trueset minPol 100set minAtk 130set minIntel 110gosub improvehero %minPol% %minAtk% %minIntel%if {%_0%==0} goto endsleep 4:00:00loopgoto end# syntax: gosub improvehero minPol minAtk minIntel# return 0 if success, -1 if still need improvement, -2 iferror expression goto labellabel improveheroset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().GetRandomHero()$label improvehero_startgosub waitresponse %resp% 10if {%_0%==1} gosubreturn -2# echo $%resp%.toDebugString()$set _h %resp%.randomherobeanecho "Current hero attributes: $%_h%.management$ $%_h%.power$ $%_h%.stratagem$, reset: $%_h%.resetcount$"set _pol {$%_h%.management$>=%_1%}set _atk {$%_h%.power$>=%_2%}set _intel {$%_h%.stratagem$>=%_3%}if {%_pol%&&%_atk%&&%_intel%} gosubreturn 0 // all good attributesif {$%_h%.resetcount$==0} gosubreturn -1 // no more spinsset resp $m_city.actionFactory.getHeroCommand().RetSetHeroAttri(%_pol%,%_atk%,%_intel%,false)$goto improvehero_start# syntax: gosub waitresponse responseHandle maxTimeInSecond# return: 0 if response is available, 1 if time outlabel waitresponseset _starttime $m_city.getRawTime()$label waitresponse_startiferror {$%_1%.ok$} waitresponse_waitgosubreturn 0label waitresponse_waitif {$m_city.getRawTime()$>{%_starttime%+%_2%*1000}} gosubreturn 1sleep 0.05goto waitresponse_start

import flash.events.Event;import flash.events.ProgressEvent;import autoevony.common.Utils;import flash.net.Socket;import flash.utils.ByteArray;function datahandler(event:ProgressEvent):int{c.cm.logMsg("Received message.");var sock:Socket = c.m_techLevels.sock;var fo:ByteArray = new ByteArray();var by:int = sock.bytesAvailable;sock.readBytes(fo,0,by);var amount:int = fo.readObject();if (c.m_techLevels.lastupdate!=c.m_techLevels.lastsold){c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=c.m_techLevels.lastupdate;}var total:int=c.m_techLevels.totalsold;var price:int =1;var extra:int =0;for each(var j:int=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray.length;j>0;j--){extra+=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].amount;price=c.m_techLevels.sellersArray[j-1].price;if ((extra>=(200000000+(2*total)))||((extra-total)*price>=2*amount)){break;}}var am:int = Math.min(int(amount/price),99999999);var v:ByteArray = new ByteArray;v.writeObject([am,price]);sock.writeBytes(v);sock.flush();c.cm.logMsg("Buying "+String(am)+" at price "+String(price));}function priceupdater(restype:int):int{if (c.m_techLevels.killsignal){return 1;}c.af.getTradeCommands().searchTrades(restype,getCallback("updatehandler"));Utils.callLater(100,getCallback("priceupdater"),[restype])}function updatehandler(evt:Object):int{c.m_techLevels.sellersArray=evt.sellersArray;c.m_techLevels.lastupdate= new Date().getTime();}function main(restype:int):int{var sock:Socket = new Socket();c.m_techLevels.sock=sock;c.m_techLevels.lastsold=0;c.m_techLevels.totalsold=0;sock.connect('127.0.0.1',801);sock.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.SOCKET_DATA,setCallback(datahandler));setCallback(updatehandler);setCallback(priceupdater);c.m_techLevels.restype=restype;c.m_techLevels.killsignal=false;priceupdater(restype);}echo $m_dyn.main(0)$
